title: TerminalWorld: Benchmarking Agents on Real-World Terminal Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2605.22535v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce TerminalWorld, a scalable data engine that automatically reverse-engineers high-fidelity evaluation tasks from "in-the-wild" terminal recordings. Processing 80,870 terminal recordings, the engine yields a full benchmark of 1,530 validated tasks, spanning 18 real-world categories, ranging from short everyday operations to workflows exceeding 50 steps, and covering 1,280 unique commands. From these, we curate a Verified subset of 200 diverse, manually reviewed tasks. Comprehensive benchmarking on TerminalWorld-Verified across eight frontier models and six agents reveals that current systems still struggle with authentic terminal workflows, achieving a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%. Moreover, TerminalWorld captures real-world terminal capabilities distinct from existing expert-curated benchmarks (e.g., Terminal-Bench), with only a weak correlation to their scores (Pearson r=0.20). translated_title: TerminalWorld：在真实世界终端任务上对智能体进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 我们推出了TerminalWorld，这是一个可扩展的数据引擎，能够从“真实场景中”的终端记录自动逆向工程出高保真的评估任务。该引擎处理了80,870条终端记录，产出了包含1,530个经过验证任务的完整基准，涵盖18个真实世界类别，从简短的日常操作到超过50个步骤的工作流程，覆盖1,280个独特命令。在此基础上，我们精心挑选出一个包含200个多样化、经人工审查任务的Verified（已验证）子集。在TerminalWorld-Verified上对八个前沿模型和六个智能体进行的全面基准测试表明，当前系统在真实终端工作流程方面仍然存在困难，最高通过率仅为62.5%。此外，TerminalWorld所捕捉的真实世界终端能力与现有专家策划的基准（如Terminal-Bench）有所不同，与其分数仅有微弱的相关性（Pearson r=0.20）。这一自动化引擎使TerminalWorld能够持续扩展。
tldr: 本文提出TerminalWorld——一个能从真实终端记录中自动逆向生成高保真评估任务的可扩展数据引擎，构建出包含1,530个验证任务的大规模终端智能体基准，并揭示当前前沿模型在真实终端工作流上的最高通过率仅为62.5%，且其表现与现有专家策划基准仅呈弱相关。
en_tdlr: TerminalWorld is a scalable data engine that automatically reverse-engineers high-fidelity evaluation tasks from real-world terminal recordings, yielding a benchmark of 1,530 tasks on which frontier agents achieve a maximum pass rate of only 62.5%, with only weak correlation (Pearson r=0.20) to expert-curated benchmarks like Terminal-Bench.
